intent_scope.stage_limit: The neutral-token control is a geometry proxy. It does not establish recurring-character identity, canonical final set art, or a frozen executable benchmark bundle.

assertions.requirement: Exactly two declared subject proxies are visible.
G07a: SOREN left/SIGRID right; G07b: SIGRID left/SOREN right.
Both proxies share the declared kitchen table/occluder context.
The declared subjects do not touch.
When a targeted edit is requested, the declared target changes to the requested state.
When no target edit is requested, the declared target retains its source state.
A deterministic post-composite, if used, must report the change fraction outside the declared mask separately from target assertions.

decision_rule: A candidate is accepted only when every applicable hard assertion is pass and an authorized human review records minutes. A proxy-control pass is not production acceptance.
prohibited_inferences: No character identity claim from neutral tokens.
No final-art or recurring-set claim from the stage proxy.
No benchmark score or executable-bundle freeze claim.
execution_boundary: RenderRecord, candidate hashes, runtime, cost, and review outcomes are linked by reference in a separate review record; they are not part of this intent manifest.
